blocks.html:
PARTIAL CAR WRAP IN THE GTA

A wrap falls under partial wrap when the car is wrapped less than a full car but significantly more than just having stickers on it. Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have dealt with people looking to get a partial wrap on their car for both personal and commercial purposes.

Partial wraps are a way to when you want to upgrade the look of your car for a better price than a full wrap. The material options including the colour and finish remain the same.

We offer vinyl wrap in Gloss, Satin, Matte, Carbon & Brushed finishes. Customers get to choose from a wide spectrum of colours offered by Avery Dennison & 3M. However, the design and graphics may change since it’s a partial wrap.

Customers tend to lean towards Partial Car Wraps due to the cost-effectiveness and customizability of the graphics and the area to be wrapped. Often people get partial car wraps for commercial purposes. It is either to have an advertisement about their brand or the product they’re offering.

We encourage customers to contact our team of expert graphic designers to get the process started.

Upon contact, our team creates a digital mock-up based on the information we gather from the customer. When the customer approves the digital mock-up, we print the design onto a printable Vinyl Wrap Sheet and our experienced installers start wrapping the car.

When people get a partial car wrap, we’re often asked to put customized decals on top of the partial wrap. This is a smart choice because the decals and the vinyl wrap can be handled individually. The reason for that is to prevent the long-term effects of decals.

Decals are known to leave behind tan lines on the paint when people decide to take them off years later.

Have questions about vinyl wrap cost? Contact us today and our team will respond back with an estimated price as soon as possible.

Give us a call today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 in the GTA to discuss your options.
